**FROM STATE INTEGRALS TO q-SERIES**

*STAVROS GAROUFALIDIS AND RINAT KASHAEV*

16 pp, 15 sections.

**Abstract.** It is well-known to the experts that multi-dimensional state integrals of prod- ucts of Faddeev’s quantum dilogarithm which arise in Quantum Topology can be written as ﬁnite sums of products of basic hypergeometric series in q =e2πiτ and ˜q =e−2πi/τ . We illustrate this fact by giving a detailed proof for a family of one-dimensional integrals which includes state-integral invariants of 4 1 and 52 knots.
